
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19392908" title="发布于 2025-12-24 15:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">关于Agentic AI的一些总结和思考</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>引用Google Gemini的释义：</p>
<p>Agentic AI frameworks are&nbsp;software toolkits that provide structure, components, and protocols for building autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, and act to achieve goals, streamlining development with features like memory, tool integration (APIs), and multi-agent orchestration, with popular examples including&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub"><a class="GI370e" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=AutoGen&amp;sca_esv=1a5899b9da7a2cf9&amp;sxsrf=AE3TifPdjtqWcQWWKJzHfYKuBTeM_d06Sw%3A1766554845653&amp;ei=3XxLaerTJ6aa2roPtPjfsQw&amp;oq=agentic+ai+&amp;gs_lp=Egxnd3Mtd2l6LXNlcnAiC2FnZW50aWMgYWkgKgIIADIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIIEAAYgAQYsQMyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIOEAAYgAQYsQMYgwEYigVIiDFQAFj7H3ACeAGQAQGYAdUEoAGeIaoBCzEuMS44LjMuMS4xuAEDyAEA-&amp;sclient=gws-wiz-serp&amp;mstk=AUtExfDPsRmUCCqYRf1z4hR47f-IwwEuYRFX2OKsILw8umm3nminB4CzBn65R6CK-ilCBFb9-pCDDoTFRcrJ5d0-RSl9325C75-06QwictOXteEoAeXEX_pYPAjrvLQXoLhHNI1IiMUxzeyDF6dHcDFVMexUlGhyRKx3Tju8I2I6CV0P8uQ&amp;csui=3&amp;ved=2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIARAC" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_c" data-ved="2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIARAC" data-hveid="CAEQAg" rel="noopener nofollow">AutoGen</a>,&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub">CrewAI,&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub">LangGraph, and&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub"><a class="GI370e" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=Semantic+Kernel&amp;sca_esv=1a5899b9da7a2cf9&amp;sxsrf=AE3TifPdjtqWcQWWKJzHfYKuBTeM_d06Sw%3A1766554845653&amp;ei=3XxLaerTJ6aa2roPtPjfsQw&amp;oq=agentic+ai+&amp;gs_lp=Egxnd3Mtd2l6LXNlcnAiC2FnZW50aWMgYWkgKgIIADIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIIEAAYgAQYsQMyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIOEAAYgAQYsQMYgwEYigVIiDFQAFj7H3ACeAGQAQGYAdUEoAGeIaoBCzEuMS44LjMuMS4xuAEDyAEA-&amp;sclient=gws-wiz-serp&amp;mstk=AUtExfDPsRmUCCqYRf1z4hR47f-IwwEuYRFX2OKsILw8umm3nminB4CzBn65R6CK-ilCBFb9-pCDDoTFRcrJ5d0-RSl9325C75-06QwictOXteEoAeXEX_pYPAjrvLQXoLhHNI1IiMUxzeyDF6dHcDFVMexUlGhyRKx3Tju8I2I6CV0P8uQ&amp;csui=3&amp;ved=2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIARAD" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_g" data-ved="2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIARAD" data-hveid="CAEQAw" rel="noopener nofollow">Semantic Kernel</a>, enabling complex automation beyond simple prompts.<span class="uJ19be notranslate" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_h,vjowhb_i,vjowhb_j"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=vjowhb_h/TKHnVd;">&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="otQkpb" data-animation-nesting="" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true">Core Components &amp; Capabilities</div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true">
<li data-hveid="CAQQAA" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true"><a class="GI370e" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=Planning+%26+Reasoning&amp;sca_esv=1a5899b9da7a2cf9&amp;sxsrf=AE3TifPdjtqWcQWWKJzHfYKuBTeM_d06Sw%3A1766554845653&amp;ei=3XxLaerTJ6aa2roPtPjfsQw&amp;oq=agentic+ai+&amp;gs_lp=Egxnd3Mtd2l6LXNlcnAiC2FnZW50aWMgYWkgKgIIADIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIIEAAYgAQYsQMyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIOEAAYgAQYsQMYgwEYigVIiDFQAFj7H3ACeAGQAQGYAdUEoAGeIaoBCzEuMS44LjMuMS4xuAEDyAEA-&amp;sclient=gws-wiz-serp&amp;mstk=AUtExfDPsRmUCCqYRf1z4hR47f-IwwEuYRFX2OKsILw8umm3nminB4CzBn65R6CK-ilCBFb9-pCDDoTFRcrJ5d0-RSl9325C75-06QwictOXteEoAeXEX_pYPAjrvLQXoLhHNI1IiMUxzeyDF6dHcDFVMexUlGhyRKx3Tju8I2I6CV0P8uQ&amp;csui=3&amp;ved=2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIBBAB" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_18" data-ved="2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIBBAB" data-hveid="CAQQAQ" data-processed="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Planning &amp; Reasoning</a>:&nbsp;Breaking down tasks, selecting tools, tracking progress.</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAQQAg" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true"><a class="GI370e" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=Autonomy&amp;sca_esv=1a5899b9da7a2cf9&amp;sxsrf=AE3TifPdjtqWcQWWKJzHfYKuBTeM_d06Sw%3A1766554845653&amp;ei=3XxLaerTJ6aa2roPtPjfsQw&amp;oq=agentic+ai+&amp;gs_lp=Egxnd3Mtd2l6LXNlcnAiC2FnZW50aWMgYWkgKgIIADIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyCBAAGIAEGLEDMgUQABiABDIIEAAYgAQYsQMyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIOEAAYgAQYsQMYgwEYigVIiDFQAFj7H3ACeAGQAQGYAdUEoAGeIaoBCzEuMS44LjMuMS4xuAEDyAEA-&amp;sclient=gws-wiz-serp&amp;mstk=AUtExfDPsRmUCCqYRf1z4hR47f-IwwEuYRFX2OKsILw8umm3nminB4CzBn65R6CK-ilCBFb9-pCDDoTFRcrJ5d0-RSl9325C75-06QwictOXteEoAeXEX_pYPAjrvLQXoLhHNI1IiMUxzeyDF6dHcDFVMexUlGhyRKx3Tju8I2I6CV0P8uQ&amp;csui=3&amp;ved=2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIBBAD" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_1c" data-ved="2ahUKEwjz1py109WRAxWUklYBHXX2AzwQgK4QegQIBBAD" data-hveid="CAQQAw" data-processed="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Autonomy</a>:&nbsp;Operating independently, adjusting strategies.</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAQQBA" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true">Memory:&nbsp;Retaining context and past actions for better reasoning.</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAQQBQ" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true">Tool Integration:&nbsp;Accessing external APIs, databases, and systems.</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAQQBg" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true">Multi-Agent Orchestration:&nbsp;Coordinating multiple agents for complex workflows.</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAQQBw" data-processed="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-processed="true">Human-AI Interaction:&nbsp;Interfaces for feedback and oversight.<span class="uJ19be notranslate" data-wiz-uids="vjowhb_1p,vjowhb_1q,vjowhb_1r" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=vjowhb_1p/TKHnVd;" data-processed="true">&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-processed="true">这里其实应该先看一下GenAI和AgenticAI的区别</span></p>
<blockquote><strong>GenAI 解决“生成什么”，Agentic AI 解决“为了目标要做什么、下一步做什么”。</strong></blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202512/23525-20251224150439443-1162336740.png" alt="image" width="703" height="192" loading="lazy"></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">👉 <strong>GenAI 是“会写、会说、会生成”的大脑</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">👉 <strong>Agentic AI 是“会思考下一步并动手”的数字员工</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>GenAI 擅长</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">文本生成（文案、代码、方案）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">总结、改写、翻译</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">单轮或多轮问答</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">规则内推理（RAG + Prompt）</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;从<span class="s1">本质上看：<strong>“输入 → 输出”</strong></span></p>
<h3><strong>Agentic AI 擅长</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">拆解目标</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">制定计划</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">调用工具 / 系统</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">多步执行</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">根据结果动态调整策略</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;从<span class="s1">本质上看是：<strong>“目标 → 行动闭环”</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>二者在关键技术上的差异有<br></strong></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202512/23525-20251224150624128-1338682233.png" alt="image" width="727" height="258" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote><strong>Agentic AI = GenAI + 规划 + 工具 + 状态 + 决策</strong></blockquote>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
</div>
